title: Destiny's Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji poured all his Heavenly Fate into the Tianji Record Fragment, the Dragon Vein Core erupted with a light that tore through the heavens—a desperate all-or-nothing confrontation against the Will of Heaven.

text.content: The darkness of the Dragon Vein Core seemed to come alive. The moment Chen Ji's foot touched that region, a will surpassing human comprehension crashed over him like a tide—not intimidation, but the crushing weight of existence itself. Every cell in his body screamed, every meridian trembled, and even the Tianji Record Fragment's circulation within him ground to a halt. What manner of being was this? Chen Ji exhausted all his imagination yet could not sketch even a fraction of its form. As if the entire heaven and earth before it were merely a chess game yet to be played.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." A voice rang out in his mind—not sound, but direct烙印 on his soul's deepest core. That voice carried no emotion, no temperature, yet every word weighed like mountains. "You have finally arrived."

text.content: Chen Ji wanted to speak, yet found his lips frozen. That will merely rippled slightly and rendered him immovable—how vast was this disparity in power? He had once believed that with the Tianji Record, he had touched the edge of destiny. Now it seemed he was merely an ant flattering itself beneath a giant's toe. Fear coiled around his heart like a venomous snake, but those eyes hidden behind a mask of cowardice grew increasingly clear. The more dangerous, the calmer. This was Chen Ji's instinct, carved into his marrow.

dialogue.content: "You are afraid, yet also calculating." The voice carried a hint of amusement, as if examining prey finally caught in its palm. "Interesting. Is this the one most suited to become the chessboard among all the prophets throughout history?"

text.content: Chessboard? Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Tianji Record's text whirled through his mind, piecing this sentence together with every fragment he knew—a terrifying truth taking shape. Every use of his Foresight Ability, every attempt to peer into the future, was not a mere gift, but rather... positioning? He suddenly recalled Mo Xiansheng's profound words: "The Tianji Record is not a treasure, but a key." What did the key open?

dialogue.content: "You understand." A thread of approval came from that will, like a god gazing down at an ant finally learning to think. "The Tianji Record is indeed a key. And you—" the voice paused, "are both key and chessboard. Every prophet throughout history has been a piece I positioned. And you are the only one qualified to become the chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji's blood froze solid in that moment. Chessboard—not a piece, but the board that carries pieces. All his foresight, all his positioning, all his scheming—instead of him playing chess, was the chessboard being filled by pieces? What did this mean? Every time he used the Tianji Record, he placed another piece on this invisible board, until... "Checkmate." Chen Ji exhausted all his strength,挤出这两个字 from between his teeth.

dialogue.content: "Clever." No emotion could be detected in that voice, yet it made Chen Ji feel bone-deep cold. "Every time you use your Foresight Ability, you place another piece on the board. You have made 579 moves. From checkmate, 121 remain."

text.content: 579 moves. Chen Ji's heart剧烈跳动. From the moment he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, every foresight, every stratagem, every narrow escape—was he actually digging his own grave? He recalled those heart-pounding moments—every time he thought himself infallible, was it merely another pattern on the chessboard? How ironic, how absurd. He, Chen Ji, who boasted of calculating all under heaven, was ultimately just a trapped beast on another's chessboard.

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heaven presented the first choice: accept the rules, become the perfect chessboard, await the arrival of Chapter 700.

choices.description: Avoid direct confrontation, stabilize the situation first, secretly seek loopholes in this chessboard of destiny.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily lose the will to resist
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about the chess game's rules
choices.risk_hint: May be viewed as completely surrendered, losing the opportunity for resistance

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, responding only with silence. He was waiting—waiting for that supreme being to reveal even a single flaw. Was the relationship between chessboard and pieces truly one-way? Mo Xiansheng's words surfaced in his mind again: "The Tianji Record is not a treasure, but a key." A key... may not be unable to open the lock in reverse.

choices.description: Directly question: Why choose me? Does the rule itself have flaws?
choices.visible_cost: Expose the depth of one's thinking
choices.visible_reward: May gain crucial information, probe the opponent's limits
choices.risk_hint: May be perceived as a threat, prematurely "checkmated"

dialogue.content: "Why me?" Chen Ji's voice was hoarse and low, yet carried an unyielding sharpness. "Since I am the chessboard, who is the opponent in this game? You? Or..." He did not finish, but the light in those eyes spoke volumes.

text.content: A long silence stretched on. Chen Ji felt time seemed to freeze, yet also seemed to pass in an instant. That supreme will seemed to be examining him—not with eyes, but with some form of perception beyond the senses. After a moment, that voice rang out again, carrying an almost imperceptible... interest? "You wish to know the complete rules?" That voice held a hint of amusement. "Very well. Since you are already the chessboard, you have the right to understand the gameplay of this chess game."

dialogue.content:
"The Tianji Record has nine pages. With each page unsealed, the contract between us deepens one layer. You think you are using the foresight ability, but in truth, the contract is using you."

The voice paused.

"When all nine pages are fully opened, the contract completes. You will replace me, becoming the vessel of Heavenly Dao's will—or, as you would say, the container of the Heavenly Eye."

text.content: "A thunderclap exploded in Chen Ji's mind. The result of unsealing all nine pages of the Tianji Record was not to make him the supreme powerhouse, but to become... a container? A vessel bearing Heavenly Dao's will? Those delusions of growing stronger he had believed, those moments he thought he was approaching the truth—turns out all were serving another's purpose? He thought of Mo Xiansheng—that guardian existing as a remnant soul on the first page of the Tianji Record. How much did he truly know? Was he an ally, or merely a piece in an even greater chess game?"

dialogue.content:
"'You are thinking of Mo Xiansheng.'

The voice seemed to see through all his thoughts.

"'He does indeed know much. But he cannot tell you everything—this is the contract's constraint. With each page unsealed, he can only reveal what should be said. He is like you, both pieces on the board. However...' the voice carried a meaning-laden smile, '...he chose to submit, while you...'

choice.prompt: "The Heavenly Eye revealed the other side of the rule: submission's ending is becoming a container, rebellion's ending is immediate death."

choices.text: "Continue waiting, searching for variations after the 121st move."
choices.description: "Since there are still 121 moves remaining, it means the rules themselves contain variables. Arrange pieces in secret, waiting for the possibility of reversal."
choices.risk_hint: "May never find the variable, perishing in silence."

text.content: "Chen Ji chose silence. In his heart, he calculated rapidly: 121 moves. Each foresight is a move on the board. What if... he一次性用光所有剩余的fate呢？ Not placing a piece, but—overturning the board entirely? This thought burned like fire in his heart, yet his face remained deathly calm."

choices.text: "Directly ask: can the Heavenly Fate Lock Key destroy the chess game?"
choices.description: "Use Chen Nian's existence to probe loopholes in the rules—if her foresight visions are all blurry, it proves she can interfere with the Tianji Record."
choices.visible_reward: "May find the key to restraining the Heavenly Eye."
choices.risk_hint: "May be seen as using family as a bargaining chip, losing moral advantage."

dialogue.content: "'What if a piece appears outside the chess pattern?' Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. 'For instance... a person unaffected by the Tianji Record's foresight.' He did not speak Chen Nian's name, but the determination in those eyes spoke volumes."

text.content: "The Heavenly Eye's will flickered at that moment—this was the first time Chen Ji sensed change in this supreme existence. Was it anger? Wariness? Or... fear? 'You are speaking of Chen Nian.' The voice no longer sounded cold, but carried an indecipherable undertone. 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Did you think I didn't know of her existence?' The voice dropped low, like whispers from an abyss, 'Did you think the Holy Sect took her for what reason?'"

"Chen Ji's heart felt as if gripped by an invisible hand. The Holy Sect taking Chen Nian—not coincidence, but part of this chess game? His sister, the person he had desperately sought, was entangled in this catastrophe from the start? Rage surged through his veins like magma, yet Chen Ji maintained his outward composure. His fingers trembled slightly within his sleeves—that was the tremor of rage pushed to its extreme yet forcibly suppressed. Remembered. This debt, he would remember. Whether against Heaven or the Holy Sect, he would make them pay."

dialogue.content:
"'You hate me.'

An almost-smile appeared in that voice.

"'This is good. A piece without hatred is merely dead wood. But I must tell you—Chen Nian's existence truly is the only variable in this chess game. Yet variables may not necessarily favor you.'

The will pressed down again, and Chen Ji felt his very soul trembling.

"'Now, you have two choices. First, obediently walk to Chapter 700, where you will meet your death—that is the most dignified ending. Second...' the voice turned sharply cold, '...die now.'"

choice.prompt: "The Heavenly Eye delivered its final ultimatum: submit and walk toward death at Chapter 700, or be immediately erased."

choices.description: "Choose the third path: appear to accept on the surface, but actually bet all remaining Heavenly Fate, gambling on an impossible comeback."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain a one-time opportunity to explosively release all Heavenly Fate."
choices.risk_hint: "If one fails, everything is lost, including the possibility of rescuing Chen Nian."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly lowered his head. The will sensed submission—an ant choosing to bow before a god. Yet only Chen Ji himself knew what turbulent waves churned behind those lowered eyes. Heavenly Fate Value: only fifty-three points remaining. All poured into the Tianji Record Fragment, gambling on the possibility of overturning the chessboard.

choices.text: Directly refuse, fighting with one's life
choices.description: Immediately activate all Heavenly Fate Value to counterattack, not giving the Heavenly Dao's Eye time to react. Even if death comes, die on the path of resistance.
choices.visible_reward: May create variables for those who come after
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, very likely death with no place for burial

dialogue.content: "I, Chen Ji, never follow someone else's chess game." His voice was terrifyingly calm. The next moment, the Tianji Record Fragment erupted with dazzling light within his body—that was the radiance of all fifty-three points of Heavenly Fate Value burning, a formal declaration of war against the Heavenly Dao by a single person.

text.content: The will of the Heavenly Dao's Eye fluctuated violently in that moment—it sensed threat. An ant, an existence it could crush between its fingers, dared to resist? "Do you think you—" For the first time, emotional fluctuation appeared in that voice, yet Chen Ji could no longer hear. The Dragon Vein Core erupted with light that tore through the heavens—that was the head-on collision between Heavenly Dao's power and Heavenly Fate Value, a desperate gamble of the chessboard attempting to overturn the chess player. For the first time, the chess game of destiny showed signs of losing control.

When Chen Ji poured all his Heavenly Fate Value into the Tianji Record Fragment, the Dragon Vein Core erupted with light that tore through the heavens—a desperate gamble of direct confrontation against the Heavenly Dao's will. Mo Xiansheng's broken voice echoed in his mind: "The second page... unsealed." Those were the last words Chen Ji heard, then endless darkness swallowed him—but within that darkness, he glimpsed something. A path beyond the chess game's design, leading to an outcome no one had ever reached.
